channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Jannik Sinner oo ka baxay Australian Open kadib qalliinkii jilibka
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka Talyaaniga Jannik Sinner, oo ah kaalinta labaad adduunka, ma ka qayb geli doono Australian Open ee Janaayo, kadib qalliin lagu sameeyay jilibkiisa midig toddobaadkan.

item.title: Bangiga dhexe ee Kuuriyada Koonfureed oo dulsaarka kordhiyay, korriinka dhaqaalahana qiimeyntiisa kor u qaaday
item.description: Bangiga dhexe ee Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa Khamiista dulsaarka aasaasiga ah 0.25 dhibcood ku kordhiyay ilaa 3.25 boqolkiiba, isagoo tilmaamay korriinka xooggan ee dhaqaalaha iyo sicir-bararka ka sarreeya bartilmaameedka.

item.title: Trump iyo madaxa NATO oo Ruushka ugu baaqay inuu ka fogaado ballaarinta dagaalka Ukraine
item.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee NATO Mark Rutte ayaa bayaan wadajir ah ugu baaqay Ruushka inuu ka fogaado tallaabo kasta oo ballaarisa dagaalka Ukraine, kadib kulan albaabadu u xirnaayeen oo ka dhacay Mar-a-Lago.

item.title: NBA: Timberwolves oo 113-106 kaga adkaatay Thunder, LaMelo Ball oo dhaawac canqowga ah ka soo gaaray
item.description: Minnesota Timberwolves ayaa 113-106 kaga guuleysatay Oklahoma City Thunder kulan ka tirsan NBA Cup, iyadoo Jaden McDaniels uu dhaliyay 32 dhibcood, halka LaMelo Ball uu kulanka uga baxay dhaawac canqowga bidix ah.

item.title: NFL: Rams oo 26-13 kaga adkaatay Packers, Blake Corum oo dhigay rikoorkiisa ugu sarreeya
item.description: Los Angeles Rams ayaa Arbacadda 26-13 kaga guuleysatay Green Bay Packers, taas oo ah guushoodii shanaad ee isku xigta, iyadoo Blake Corum uu orday 184 yaard oo ah tirada ugu badan ee xirfaddiisa.

item.title: Brazil oo ku tilmaantay 'mid aan la aqbali karin' canshuuraha cusub ee Mareykanku soo jeediyay
item.description: Xafiiska madaxweynaha Brazil Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva ayaa sheegay in Brazil aysan u hoggaansami doonin hanjabaadda Mareykanka, kadib markii Washington ay soo jeedisay canshuuro cusub oo saaran diyaaradaha iyo sonkorta Brazil.

item.title: OCHA: Yaraanta lacagta gargaarka oo keentay in Soomaaliya laga xiro 233 xarumood oo nafaqo
item.description: Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee isku-duwidda arrimaha bani'aadannimada (OCHA) ayaa ka digay in malaayiin Soomaali ah ay waayi karaan adeegyada gargaarka, kadib markii yaraanta lacagta ay keentay in la xiro ugu yaraan 233 xarumood oo nafaqo.

item.title: Mareykanka oo SpaceX u oggolaaday inay gantaal ku dirto ilaa hal milyan oo dayax-gacmeed oo xarumo xog ah
item.description: Guddiga Isgaarsiinta Federaalka ee Mareykanka (FCC) ayaa Arbacadii u oggolaaday shirkadda SpaceX ee Elon Musk inay hawada sare u dirto ilaa 1 milyan oo dayax-gacmeed, oo loogu talagalay in lagu dhiso xarumo xog-keyd ah oo ku yaal meeraha agtiisa.

item.title: Kim Jong Un oo ku baaqay in Kuuriyada Waqooyi ay ballaariso hubka nukliyeerka ee taatikada ah
item.description: Hoggaamiyaha Kuuriyada Waqooyi Kim Jong Un ayaa ku baaqay in dalkiisu uu hub nukliyeer taatiko ah ka hawlgeliyo goobo badan oo hawlo kala duwan leh, isagoo sheegay in awoodda soo saarista walxaha nukliyeerka si nidaamsan loo ballaarinayo.

item.title: Ukraine oo sheegtay inay weerar ku qaadday saldhigga ciidamada cirka ee Savasleyka, shan diyaaradoodna ku waxyeelleysay
item.description: Taliska Guud ee Ciidamada Ukraine ayaa sheegay in ciidamadiisu ay weerar ku qaadeen saldhigga ciidamada cirka ee Savasleyka ee gobolka Nizhny Novgorod, bariga Moscow, kana waxyeelleeyeen shan diyaaradood oo dagaal.

item.title: Duufaanno ku dhuftay Mareykanka oo dib u dhigay dabaaldegga Macy's, California oo fatahaad u diyaar garowday
item.description: Bandhigga caanka ah ee Thanksgiving ee Macy's ee magaalada New York, oo sanadkan ah kii 100-aad, ayaa dib loogu dhigay maalinta Sabtida duufaan ku wajahan xeebta bari awgeed, halka xeebaha California ay u diyaar garoobayaan fatahaad halis ah.

item.title: Madaxweyne Samia Suluhu Hassan oo isku shaandheyn ku sameeyay golaha wasiirrada Tanzania
item.description: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa isku shaandheyn ku sameeyay golaha wasiirrada, wuxuuna magacaabay wasiirro iyo wasiir ku-xigeenno cusub, iyo afhayeen cusub oo u hadla dowladda.

item.title: Andy Taylor, gitaariistihii hore ee kooxda Duran Duran, oo ku geeriyooday da'da 65 jir
item.description: Andy Taylor, oo ahaa gitaariistihii kooxda muusigga Ingiriiska ee Duran Duran, ayaa ku geeriyooday da'da 65 jir kadib xanuun dheer oo kansarka qanjirka prostate-ka ah, sida ay 25 November sheegeen kooxda iyo qoyskiisa.

item.title: Kimmich oo si adag u dhaleeceeyay hadallada Rummenigge iyo Hoeneß ee ku saabsan Jamal Musiala
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka Bayern Munich Joshua Kimmich ayaa 25 November, kadib guuldarradii 2-1 ee ay kooxdiisu kala kulantay Lille, ku tilmaamay hadallada Karl-Heinz Rummenigge iyo Uli Hoeneß ee ku saabsanaa xaaladda Jamal Musiala wax aan gebi ahaanba la aqbali karin.

item.title: Championship: Burnley oo jabisay rikoor xun oo guriga ah, Stoke oo u dhaqaaqday kaalinta sare
item.description: Burnley ayaa 25 November 2-0 looga adkaaday garoonkeeda Turf Moor kulan ay la ciyaartay Birmingham City, waxayna hadda 24 kulan oo horyaal ah oo xiriir ah guriga ku ciyaartay iyadoon guul gaarin, taas oo ah taxanaha ugu dheer taariikhda English Football League.

item.title: Inter oo 2-0 kaga adkaatay Stuttgart, Bastoni oo dhaawac ku baxay
item.description: Inter Milan ayaa 25 November garoonka San Siro 2-0 kaga adkaatay VfB Stuttgart kulankii shanaad ee wareegga horyaalka Champions League, goolasha waxaa dhaliyay Petar Sucic iyo Lautaro Martínez, balse daafaca Alessandro Bastoni ayaa dhaawac ku baxay.

item.title: Lille oo 2-1 kaga adkaatay Bayern Munich, gool is-dhalin ah oo Pavlović ayaa go'aamiyay
item.description: Lille ayaa 25 November garoonka Pierre-Mauroy 2-1 kaga adkaatay Bayern Munich kulankii shanaad ee wareegga horyaalka Champions League, taasoo ah guuldarradii ugu horreysay ee Bayern xilli ciyaareedkan 18 kulan kadib.

item.title: Serie B: Sampdoria oo Padova ku garaacday, Avellino oo Cremona kaga guuleysatay Cremonese
item.description: Sampdoria ayaa 25 November 2-1 kaga adkaatay Padova, halka Avellino ay 1-0 kaga guuleysatay Cremonese garoonkeeda, iyadoo tababaraha caanka ah Marcelo Bielsa uu kulanka ka daawanayay fadhiyada.

item.title: Oliver Glasner oo dhaleeceeyay heerka Nottingham Forest, kuna baaqay in ciyaartoyda ay bartaan Ingiriisiga
item.description: Tababaraha Nottingham Forest Oliver Glasner ayaa 25 November sheegay in heerka kooxdu uusan ku filnayn markii uu yimid, isagoo su'aal ka keenay sababta qaar ka mid ah ciyaartoydiisu aysan ugu hadlin Ingiriisiga kadib sannado ay dalka joogeen.

item.title: PSG iyo Roma oo 2-2 ku kala tageen Paris, Malen oo rigoore ku soo celiyay barbarro
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain iyo Roma ayaa 25 November garoonka Parc des Princes ku kala tagay 2-2 kulankii shanaad ee wareegga horyaalka Champions League, iyadoo Donyell Malen uu rigoore ku dhaliyay goolka barbarraha daqiiqaddii 78-aad.

item.title: Víctor Muñoz oo jilibka ku dhaawacmay kulankii Club Brugge, Iraola-na sheegay inuu rajo qabo
item.description: Weeraryahanka Liverpool Víctor Muñoz ayaa 25 November daqiiqaddii 42-aad ka baxay kulankii Club Brugge ee Champions League kadib dhaawac jilibka ah, halka tababaraha Andoni Iraola uu sheegay in ciyaaryahanku rajo ka qabo dhaawaciisa.

item.title: Daniel Dubois oo 30 January magaalada Manchester kaga difaacaya horyaalka WBO Joseph Parker
item.description: Horyaalka adduunka ee feerka miisaanka culus ee WBO Daniel Dubois ayaa difaaciisa labaad ee horyaalka ku sameyn doona Joseph Parker, oo hore u haystay horyaalkaas, 30 January hoolka Co-op Live ee magaalada Manchester.

item.title: Florian Thauvin oo raali-gelin ka bixiyay wareysigii gaabnaa ee uu bixiyay kadib guuldarradii Lens
item.description: Kabtanka Lens Florian Thauvin ayaa 25 November raali-gelin ka bixiyay jawaabihii gaagaabnaa ee uu siiyay telefishinka Canal+, kadib markii kooxdiisa 3-1 looga adkaaday kulan Champions League ah oo ay la ciyaartay RB Leipzig.

item.title: Barcelona oo Baku 4-1 kaga adkaatay Sabah, Anthony Gordon oo laba gool dhaliyay
item.description: Barcelona ayaa 25 November garoonka Baku Olympic Stadium 4-1 kaga badiyay kooxda Sabah ee Azerbaijan, kulankii shanaad ee wareegga horyaalka Champions League, iyadoo Anthony Gordon uu dhaliyay laba gool.

item.title: NBA oo qorsheynaysa inay ugu yaraan 10 bilyan oo euro ku maalgaliso garoomada kubbadda koleyga ee Yurub
item.description: Ururka kubbadda koleyga ee Mareykanka NBA ayaa 25 November shaaciyay istaraatiijiyad lagu maalgalinayo ugu yaraan 10 bilyan oo euro horumarinta iyo dib-u-dhiska garoomada kubbadda koleyga ee qaaradda Yurub.

item.title: Dominic Calvert-Lewin iyo Leeds oo la sheegay inay isku raaceen heshiis cusub oo socda ilaa 2029
item.description: Weeraryahanka Leeds United Dominic Calvert-Lewin iyo kooxdiisa ayaa la sheegay inay 25 November isku raaceen heshiis cusub oo uu kooxda kula sii joogayo ilaa 2029, inkastoo Leeds aysan weli si rasmi ah u shaacin.

item.title: Salva Kiir oo amray in la ilaaliyo xorriyadda socodka musharixiinta ka hor ololaha doorashada Koonfur Suudaan
item.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfur Suudaan Salva Kiir ayaa 25 November amar ku siiyay ciidamada amniga iyo maamullada gobollada inay damaanad qaadaan xorriyadda socodka musharixiinta, kooxaha ololaha iyo muwaadiniinta inta lagu jiro ololaha doorashada soo socota.

item.title: Garsoorayaal Israa'iil ah oo soo jeediyay in la tuuro eedda laaluushka ee Netanyahu
item.description: Garsoorayaasha dhegaysanaya dacwadda musuqmaasuqa ee Ra'iisul Wasaaraha ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Israa'iil Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa 25 November xeer-ilaalinta u soo jeediyay inay ka noqoto mid ka mid ah eedaha laaluushka, iyagoo shaki geliyay labada kiis ee kale.

item.title: Liverpool oo 3-0 kaga adkaatay Club Brugge, Alexander Isak oo laba gool dhaliyay
item.description: Liverpool ayaa 25 November garoonka Jan Breydel ee Bruges 3-0 kaga adkaatay Club Brugge kulankii shanaad ee wareegga horyaalka Champions League, iyadoo Alexander Isak uu dhaliyay laba gool, Florian Wirtz-na mid.

item.title: Aaron Rodgers oo eedeymo culus u jeediyay tababaraha Steelers, kooxduna waxaa la sheegay inay sii deynayso
item.description: Aaron Rodgers ayaa 25 November si cad u dhaleeceeyay tababaraha Pittsburgh Steelers Mike McCarthy, isagoo ku eedeeyay inuu hurdo kulamada kooxda, maalin kadib markii kooxdu ka saartay liiska kulanka Jimcaha ee Denver Broncos.
